# Bookmarks

A small app for saving links.

## Overview

People save links and find them again later.

## Authentication

Email and password sign-in with sessions.

### Sign-up

Create an account with an email and password.

### Password reset

Send a reset link by email.

### Two-factor sign-in

Ask for a one-time code from an authenticator app after the password.

## Bookmarks API

```markdown
# Not a heading: this is inside a code fence
```

CRUD endpoints for the user's own bookmarks.

## Search & Tags

Full-text search over titles, notes and page text.

Install and configure the server.
